updates.title: v1.3.0 - App Redesign & Settings Sync Fix
updates.body:
・Completely redesigned the companion app with a modern tab-based UI (Settings + Updates).
・Fixed settings not syncing on SideStore/AltStore by dynamically resolving App Group IDs at runtime.
・Added in-app language switcher (English / Japanese).
・Update notifications now fetched from GitHub — a badge appears when a new version is available.
・App now detects if the keyboard hasn't been added yet and shows a setup alert with a direct link to iOS keyboard settings.
・Fixed the app appearing letterboxed (shrunk to the center) on modern iPhones.

updates.title: v1.2.0 - Romaji Engine Expansion
updates.body:
・Massively expanded the Romaji conversion table — now supports Hepburn, Kunrei-shiki, Nihon-shiki, and more (qa→くぁ, va→ゔぁ, kwa→くぁ, etc.).
・Added zya, fya, vya, gwa, wha, ca/ci/cu/ce/co input patterns.
・Added small kana mappings (xwa→ゎ, xka→ヵ, xke→ヶ).
・Updated wi/we to modern readings (うぃ/うぇ), with wyi/wye for classical ゐ/ゑ.

updates.title: v1.1.0 - UI Overhaul & New Features
updates.body:
・Replaced text-based Shift/Delete/Globe keys with SF Symbols for a native iOS look.
・Added slide-to-select for QWERTY long-press special characters.
・Added a/A uppercase toggle for flick alphabet mode.
・Removed unwanted shadow and blue highlight effects from keys.
・Settings app now lets you enable/disable individual keyboard modes.

updates.title: v1.0.0 - Initial Release
updates.body:
・Flick input for Japanese (Kana, Alphabet, Numbers).
・QWERTY keyboard for English and Romaji.
・Dark mode support.
・Automatic CI builds via GitHub Actions.
